note: distMpc is comoving (Planck 2018 flat LCDM, H0=67.66, Om=0.3111) when derived from redshift, otherwise the literature distance. radiusMpc is a characteristic (virial/zero-velocity/half-extent) size. Redshift is the cluster mean (CMB/helio difference << quoted precision).
rows: approx.; dominated by Milky Way and M31
Gravitationally bound group containing the Milky Way, M31 and M33; ~1.2 Mpc radius (zero-velocity surface). Centre placed along the MW-M31 line at the barycentre.
Nearest group beyond the Local Group, around M81, M82 and NGC 3077; shows tidal streams (HI bridge).
Loose filament of galaxies (NGC 253, NGC 55, NGC 300, NGC 7793) at ~2-4 Mpc.
Dominant group at ~4 Mpc around Cen A and M83.
Virgo Cluster Catalog members (Binggeli+1985 list ~2000 incl. likely members)
Nearest rich cluster, centred on M87; the Local Group falls towards it.
Rich, nearly relaxed cluster; velocity dispersion ~1000 km/s; centre of the CfA Great Wall.
Brightest X-ray cluster, centred on NGC 1275; at the end of the Perseus-Pisces chain.
Rich cluster hidden in the Zone of Avoidance, at the core of the Great Attractor region.
Nearby cluster, part of the Hydra-Centaurus region flowing toward the Great Attractor.
Nearby cluster in the Hydra-Centaurus supercluster.
Largest concentration of clusters in the nearby universe (~200 Mpc away); contributes to the Local Group motion.
Basin of attraction of ~1e17 Msun containing the Local Group, Virgo, Hydra-Centaurus; ~160 Mpc across. Centre approximated by the Great Attractor/Norma region (the flow convergence).
Filamentary chain spanning RA ~22h-4h at cz ~5000-6000 km/s.
Large nearly empty region adjacent to the Local Sheet (~45 Mpc across); the Local Group is receding from it. Position is approximate.
Sheet of galaxies ~170 h^-1 Mpc long, running through the Coma Cluster.
Filamentary wall ~1.37 Gly long found in SDSS redshifts. Position is approximate.
